speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice. To help narrow down the cause, have you noticed any pain in your abdomen, particularly in the upper right side?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain in your upper right abdomen, and have you noticed your urine becoming dark or your stools turning pale?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any darkening of your urine or lightening of your stools, and do you have any itching of the skin? REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Test

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver Function Tests show Elevated AST, Elevated ALT, Significantly elevated ALP, and Elevated Bilirubin. Urine Analysis shows Amber colored appearance and Positive Bilirubin. Abdominal Ultrasound reveals an Enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder with No evident stones. Physical examination noted Icteric skin and sclera and an Enlarged gallbladder without tenderness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your age, painless jaundice, and the specific finding of an enlarged gallbladder without stones, I am concerned about a pancreatic or biliary obstruction. REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen_Pelvis

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal CT scan is surprising given the clinical picture of painless jaundice and an enlarged gallbladder, which classically suggests a distal obstruction. Let's request high-resolution images to better visualize the pancreatic head and biliary tree for subtle masses or strictures. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and consumes 5 alcoholic beverages per day.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the classic presentation of painless jaundice with an enlarged gallbladder (Courvoisier's sign) and a history of heavy smoking, this is highly suspicious for pancreatic head cancer despite the initial normal CT. I will proceed with the diagnosis based on these strong clinical indicators. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
